issues.message: Element "root" has an invalid "visible" condition: [{"$state":"/tasks","$item":"status","eq":"todo"}]. Valid forms: true, false, {"$state":"/path","eq":value}, {"$item":"field","eq":value}, {"$index":true,"eq":n}, an array of those (AND), or {"$and":[...]} / {"$or":[...]}. Use exactly one of $state, $item, or $index per condition object.
